title: Charlotte Grenfell Bridgman Rogers
dates: (d. 1888)
---

cousin of Charlotte (Willyams) Pascoe

Daughter of the Rev.

Humphrey Willyams and Mary Grenfell, she married (14 Oct 1823) Captain Frederick Rogers (1794-1874), first cousin to Mrs Pascoe, whose book she edited;  her collaborator was perhaps Mary Sophia Rogers (d.1900), her  husband's niece [LG 1906 Willyams, Rogers]
